title: Against Marcion
author: tertullian
attributionNote: The attribution is recorded as the edition and the scholarly consensus give it; where the attribution is disputed, the work says so.
description: Tertullian's five-book refutation of Marcion, who separated the creator God of the Hebrew scriptures from the Father of Jesus. The work is the longest surviving source for Marcion's teaching and for how the church read scripture against it.
historicalContext: Written after Tertullian had joined the Montanists, against a rival Christian movement with its own canon.
availabilityNote: Streamed from the Christian Classics Ethereal Library at read time. Holmes's translation from the Ante-Nicene Fathers, served by the CCEL.
